summary.text: Carl Anderson is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 103 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
An insurance agent and minister, he has served in the House since 2004.

paragraphs.text: Carl Anderson attended L.R. Nichols Seminary and studied business administration at Horry-Georgetown Technical College in 1981.
He is an insurance agent and minister.
Anderson assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives in 2004, and his current term ends on November 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee for 2025-2026 and as first vice chair of the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
